decisions.reason: As a product that builds on the firm’s established postpress offer and remained on its own webpage in 2023 and 2024, it likely performs at least near aspiration levels and the firm’s broad portfolio gives enough slack to keep it on the market.

This add-on is close to the core business, stayed on the website through 2024, and has a reported customer use case showing practical adoption, so a behavioral-theory firm would see little reason to reallocate resources away from it.
